capabilities.text: Hang the spring from a ceiling, or lay it horizontal from a wall with the object on a floor
Show one spring, before and after, or three positions for simple harmonic motion
Use one spring, or two or three in series or in parallel
capabilities.evidence: changes:arrangement=2 in series + changes:arrangement=3 in parallel

capabilities.text: Label every spring k, or number them k₁, k₂, k₃
capabilities.note: one spring label is written on every spring; no numbering

capabilities.text: Stretch the spring, up to its natural length again
Squash the spring by up to half its length, on a floor
capabilities.note: passes on orientation alone; checked by hand that -50% squashes the horizontal spring (a hanging spring is not drawn squashed)

capabilities.text: In three positions, set the amplitude A
capabilities.note: passes on picture alone; checked by hand that the amplitude changes the three-position render

capabilities.text: Draw the coils as a zigzag or as loops
Hang a block, a ball or slotted masses
Label the object with your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Mark the extension as a dimension line
Mark the natural length as a dimension line
Draw a dashed equilibrium line
capabilities.note: show_equilibrium works only in three positions; in the static pictures the dashed line marks the natural length and follows the extension mark

capabilities.text: Draw an applied force pulling or pushing
capabilities.note: pulls on the stretched spring, pushes on the squashed one; checked by hand that the push renders differently from the horizontal pull

capabilities.text: In three positions, draw the velocity at equilibrium and the acceleration at each end
capabilities.note: both arrows are on at the opening setting; checked by hand that Velocity alone changes the three-position render

capabilities.text: In three positions, choose which way the object is moving
capabilities.note: passes on picture alone; checked by hand that the direction changes the three-position render

capabilities.text: Label the spring with your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Label the extension with your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Write a chart title
Draw in color for slides, or black and white
